messages:
Priya: Heads-up: metrics show a sudden spike in 5xx + gateway timeouts from hosted inference starting ~12:24UTC after rolling traffic slice-42. Customers SUP-993 & SUP-1001 reporting errors. Spike summary: ~18% 5xx and p95 > 3s.
SRE-Oncall: taking it. can you post the rollout id + link to deploy?
Priya: deploy id: deploy/2024-11-23/slide-42. config change was `route.seeded_config=true` applied to seed-slice. Link: https://deploys/redwood/2024/slide-42
Alex: looking at gateway logs now — seeing `upstream hang` and `context deadline exceeded` from router@edge-12. sample log: "error":"timeout waiting for upstream","route":"slice-42"
InfraBot: autoscaler metrics show no infra CPU/GPU spike. Backends show healthy instance counts. Latency correlates to route selection, not infra exhaustion.
Support: SUP-993 posted a curl repro: `curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns `502` with body `{"error":"gateway timeout"}`
Maria: digging in config-store: route selector for slice-42 references an older kernelpath sha (kernel-v1.2) — expected kernel-v1.3. That mismatch can break continuous batching and cause long blocking in some sequences.
Priya: ack. The canary was intended at 10% but the flag scope mis-applied and seeded the full slice. I pushed `--scope=env:prod` which ended up matching slice-42; reverting now.
SRE-Oncall: runbook step 1 — isolate traffic. Can we set a fallback route/model while we rollback? Command suggestion: `rbctl route set slice-42 --model=redwood/generic-v1 --weight=0`
Alex: trying a partial fallback: `rbctl route set slice-42 --model=redwood/generic-v1 --weight=0.1` ... applying -> pending. Telemetry: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% within 30s of changing weights.
Support: decrease observed, customers reporting partial recovery. Note: billing feed shows some duplicated request records for affected timeframe — opening BILL-778.
Priya: rollback plan: full rollback of the seeded_config flag for slice-42, drain existing connections on edge-12, remove legacy kernelpath selector. I'll coordinate with infra — ETA ~5m.
Maria: grabbing traces for failed requests. example trace id: trc_0x9a3f. snippet: ```json
{"route":"slice-42","error":"kvcache_mismatch","duration_ms":3100}
``` This looks like KV cache priming failed for kernel-v1.2 and caused timeouts on some requests.
SRE-Oncall: executing rollback: `featurectl rollback seeded_config --target slice-42`
InfraBot: rollback API response: success. Draining pods on edge-12, applying desired config (kernel-v1.3) to routing table.
Alex: observability update: 5xx down to ~0.8% and p95 back to ~200ms. Dashboards: https://dashboards/redwood/incidents/1729801234
Support: SUP-1001 confirms green. I'll inform affected customers we rolled back and will follow up with RCA. Linking incidents: SUP-993, SUP-1001, billing BILL-778.
Priya: next actions: full RCA/postmortem. Add guardrail to prevent `--scope` misapply (validate selector matches intended slice), add a smoke test to rollout pipeline to detect kernelpath mismatch. Owners: Maria -> RCA, Alex -> telemetry/alert tuning, Priya -> rollout guard implementation.
SRE-Oncall: :thumbsup: I'll move this to ready-for-postmortem and update when doc is live.
Support: Notifying affected customers now. SUP-993 & SUP-1001 updated.
Priya: incident closed for now, transitioning to postmortem phase.
